# Third-party crypto vendors

| Component | Origin | License |
|-----------|--------|---------|
| Ed25519, SHA512, Curve25519, Hash, BigNumberUtil, Crypto | Arduino Crypto (Rhys Weatherley / arduinolibs) | MIT |
| micro-ecc (`uECC`) | Kenneth MacKay | BSD-2-Clause |

Used for dual-curve Xahau key derivation and signing on host and Arduino without external PlatformIO registry deps.
